doc_friction.issue: Four 2026-11-12 records called the site-builder suite's 172 failures environmental; seeding a bad post reproduced exactly 172, 168 sharing one error. The 12-line tail showed only the TAP summary. Fixed in this PR (failed steps print distinct errors with counts).

doi.org, api.crossref.org, export.arxiv.org, api.openalex.org, api.semanticscholar.org and api.datacite.org all return 000 / refused through this container's proxy; no alternate host to fall back to, so nothing to fix in the tool.

Backlog held only owner rows again; of the top friction reports checked, three were already fixed (build.mjs import side effect, --list as dry run, post checks run first). Grouping the run records' doc_friction by file for today found the live one fastest.

notes: Critique mode. main_health.py on main: 60/60 pass. platform/pages full suite on clean main: 1570 pass, 0 fail, 21 skipped, 352 s. pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: reproduce a misread CI failure, add error grouping with tests, write a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
